sections.title: Saját means own
sections.content: *saját* means 'own' and stands in front of the noun. It never changes: the noun after it still carries the ending that says whose it is. *a saját kulcsom* is 'my own key' and *a saját kulcsod* is 'your own key'. With *van* it says that something is yours alone: *Van saját szobám.* (I have my own room.) *egy* is usually left out before *saját*: *Van egy szobám* is 'I have a room', *Van saját szobám* is 'I have my own room'.
Don't add an ending to *saját* itself: it stays *saját* for every person. The noun after it carries the ending, so the owner is always shown once.
